description_html:
🧲 MagTuning – Make Mags Better

This mod tweaks mags in SPT so they don’t suck as much.

Simple. Fast. Tunable. 💥

🔧 What It Does

  • 🔫 Fixes weird mag ergonomics (flips negatives or adds points)
  • 🏃‍♂️ Speeds up reload/check time (or makes it less painful)
  • 📦 Lets you double mag size (if you want to go full chad)
  • 🛠️ Easy config to turn stuff on/off or change values
  • 🐛 Debug mode if you want to see what’s changing

🤔 Why?

Some mags feel like garbage. This helps.

You’re welcome. 😎

📁 How to Use

  1. 🧩 Drop the MagTuning folder into user/mods

  2. ✏️ Open config.json to:

    • ✅ Turn features on/off
    • 🔢 Set adjustment amounts
    • 🚀 Double mag capacity
    • 🐞 Toggle debug logging

📝 Notes

  • ✅ Works with SPT-AKI 3.11.x
  • 🧼 Safe to use — only edits stat values

Try the defaults — they’re nice. Or break the game. I won’t judge.

Have fun. 🎯
